name: Rock Paper Scissors
summary: Story of three girls who stay together in an apartment. The story revolves around the little and witty moments in their life.

name: Average Ambili
summary: This mini web series revolves around a youngster who's been bullied as a child for being average in academic and non-academic activities at school. Though Ambili has ambitions and wishes to do something really thoughtful she doesn't get any job for the same reason - being ‘average' even at job interviews. The storyline continues to follow Ambili and some unexpected events she faces in her so-called ‘average' life.

name: Bharati Apartments
summary: Story revolves around an apartment and its residents

name: Sebastiante Velliyazhcha
summary: Follows Sebastian who is an aspiring film maker facing problems one by one while chasing his dream

name: Super League: The War for Football
summary: The War for Football is a four-part series that documents the high stakes battle that is set off when plans for a breakaway league emerge and the past, present and future of European football collide, leaving the game's most powerful leaders to defend, or upend, the traditions of the sport. With unprecedented access to league presidents, club owners and the architects behind the European Super League, the docuseries brings fans the yet untold story of how and why this idea was hatched and the battle plans that were formed to fight it.

name: Love Me in Three Days
summary: Shan Yi Fan suffers from a strange disease; if he has five seconds of physical contact with someone he will change into that person's appearance and won't be able to change back until three days later. One day, he transforms into Luo Luo's cheating ex-boyfriend during the middle of their arguing and she mistakenly follows him instead, only to accidentally kiss. Surprisingly he transforms back to himself! With Luo Luo's kiss being his antidote, what else is a domineering CEO to do but to keep her by his side at all costs.

name: Liar's Love
summary:
Su Tang is an art gallery director and art appraiser, the only daughter of the famous florist Su Zhiyu. Her mother died young, but Tan received a good education from childhood, she was very pampered, and she grew up in an atmosphere of love. Her husband Peng Jae is calm and thoughtful. He went through a painful childhood experience associated with the divorce of his parents, and grew up with his father.
Su Tan and Peng Jae run an art gallery together, and their marriage seems perfect and full of love. But what if one day you find out that the person sleeping next to you is a terrible serial killer?

name: All Stars
summary: All Stars follows a former cheerleader from Daytona Beach who cons her way across the pond to teach cheerleading at a school in coastal England and has to show a ragtag group of students – and herself – how to be All Stars.

name: Toonheads
summary: Anthology series focusing on the golden age of American Animation. Each episode features full cartoons with commentary and the history behind some of the greatest cartoon shorts ever.

name: Sex Diaries
summary: Inspired by New York Magazine's column, Sex Diaries shares short stories of eight individuals as they navigate sex and dating in New York City.

previousepisode.name: The Truck Driver Learning Love Is Messy/The Dad Finding Love on TikTok

name: George & Leo
summary: Mild-mannered Martha's Vineyard bookstore owner George Stoody turns a new page in his life (and gets a bad paper cut) when he meets his daughter-in-law's dad, Leo Wagonman, an abrasive, smalltime hood on the run from Las Vegas mobsters. Leo hasn't seen his daughter, Casey, in 20 years, and she likes it that way, but George's well-meaning son, Ted, has invited him to their wedding -- and once Leo sees that there's a spare room above George's shop, he decides that he has found the perfect hideout.

name: Get Fit with Brittas
summary: Chris Barrie revives his Gordon Brittas character for this series of public information films.

name: 413 Hope Street
summary: 413 Hope Street is set at a New York City youth-crisis center built by a man whose son had been gunned down at the site.

name: Chillin' in My 30s After Getting Fired from the Demon King's Army
summary: The dark soldier, Dariel (30 years old), who can't use magic despite being in the Demon Lord's army, was fired for his lack of capacity. Having been raised by the previous Demon Lord himself, he finds that his adoptive brother, the new Demon Lord, has little use for him. However, after rescuing a village girl from a forest monster, Dariel is invited into her village and starts realizing that he may be considerably more powerful than what he thought...

name: Spy Classroom
summary:
After a gruesome war wreaked havoc on the general populace, the governments of the world turned to a more elusive tactic to further their agendas—a war fought in the shadows.

Lily, a beautiful girl with white locks, is a student in one of the many institutions that train youths into becoming capable spies. Unfortunately, despite scoring well in the written exams, she only manages to barely pass her practicals. With no real world skills to speak of, her hopes of graduating are dismal—until she is offered an opportunity to join the mysterious team "Tomoshibi" and partake in an Impassable Mission.

Excited by the prospect of working with the elite, Lily enthusiastically accepts. However, she is struck dumb when she arrives at Kagerou Palace and the true purpose of Tomoshibi and its hopeless situation comes into light. Joined by other problematic female spies along with a mysterious young man spearheading the operation, Lily realizes that this is not the ideal escapade she had pictured.

name: My Life as Inukai-san's Dog
summary: The story follows the protagonist who wakes up one day transformed as Pochita, a pet dog of his cool and beautiful classmate Karen Inukai.

name: Ayakashi Triangle
summary:
Matsuri Kazamaki and Suzu Kanade are childhood friends, bonded by their shared ability to see ayakashi—youkai in search of a life force to devour. However, in high school, their relationship deteriorates. As Suzu's one-sided feelings are growing, so is the difference in their ayakashi views: Matsuri considers all ayakashi a threat to his friend, while Suzu is an ayakashi medium—someone who exudes a significant amount of life force compared to the average human—and loves them all despite the risk.

When the two stumble upon a talking white cat named Shirogane, they are unaware that it is a four-hundred-year-old ayakashi known as the "King of Ayakashi." He is hell-bent on gaining even more power by devouring Suzu, but as Matsuri swoops in to try and save her by sealing Shirogane's powers, the ayakashi uses a jutsu to turn him into a girl instead!

Matsuri vows to protect Suzu from further harm as her best friend, but he must learn how to act like a girl until his grandfather—a famous wind jutsu exorcist ninja—can undo the jutsu. Meanwhile, Suzu must work out her romantic feelings for Matsuri now that he is no longer a boy. But when Matsuri takes the king as his pet, the future of the two friends seems uncertain.

previousepisode.name: Kanade Suzu the King of Ayakashi

name: Kaina of the Great Snow Sea
summary: The "boy-meets-girl high fantasy" is set in a world where land is being swallowed by the encroaching Great Snow Sea. Humaniy ekes out a harsh life above the Tenmaku (a wordplay on the Japanese word for tent) that stretches from the roots to the tops of giant Orbital Trees. The story centers around Kaina, a boy who lives above the Tenmaku, and Liliha, the princess of the small country Atland in the Great Snow Sea.

name: SuperKitties
summary: Set in the city of Kittydale, each SuperKitties episode features two stories as the four kittens, cuddled up at the Purr 'N' Play playspace or out playing around town, receive a "SuperKitty Call" from one of their animal friends with a problem that only the SuperKitties can help with, usually caused by one of the comedic villains in the series: Cat Burglar, Mr. Puppypaws, Lab Rat or Zsa-Zsa. With plenty of super skills and gadgets at their disposal, the SuperKitties set off to thwart the villains' plans and impart important messages along the way.

name: High Card
summary: After discovering that his orphanage was on the brink of closing due to financial stress, Finn, who was living freely on the streets, set out for a casino with the aim of making a fortune. However, nothing could have prepared Finn for the nightmare that was awaiting him. Once there, Finn encountered a car chase and bloody shootout caused by a manʼs "lucky" card. Finn will eventually learn what the shootout was about. The world order can be controlled by a set of 52 X-Playing cards with the power to bestow different superhuman powers and abilities to the ones that possess them. With these cards, people can access the hidden power of the "buddy" that can be found within themselves. There is a secret group of players called High Card, who have been directly ordered by the king of Fourland to collect the cards that have been scattered throughout the kingdom, while moonlighting as employees of the luxury car maker Pinochle. Scouted to become the groupʼs fifth member, Finn soon joins the players on a dangerous mission to find these cards. "All you need in life are manners, dignity, and the will to bet on your own life." However, Whoʼs Who, the rival car maker obsessed with defeating Pinochle, and the Klondikes, the infamous Mafia family, stand in the way of the gang. A frenzied battle amongst these card obsessed players, fueled by justice, desire, and revenge, is about to begin!

name: Andersen Monogatari
summary: Adaptation of Hans Christian Andersen's stories, introduced and told by Chianti and Zucco

name: Ringa Ringa Rosa
summary: Fast Paced comedy story of a young man who is finding a thief who stoles his ring.

name: All Exclusive
summary: In a new documentary interview experiment, the focus is on the meeting between Casper Christensen and his hand-picked guests - where the viewers get a completely new insight into the lives and personalities of both Casper and the guests.

name: Живчик та його друзі
summary: They look like you. Perhaps, they even study at your school or live in the neighboring courtyard. They are outstanding footballers and golfers, almost to dip in five minutes of squadrons, young sculptors and promising cinemas. Exactly this, they are famous gamers, extremists, intellectuals and heart-runners. And most importantly - they know what a sweet friendship is. Get acquainted: Zhyvchyk and his friends.

name: Side Quest
summary: Side Quest will explore the lives of employees, players and fans who are impacted by the game. The new extension series takes a page out of the acclaimed departure episodes of "Mythic Quest," including the upcoming episode "Sarian."

name: Princess Power
summary: Princess friends from four different Fruitdoms — Blueberry, Kiwi, Pineapple and Raspberry — spring into action to make their worlds a better place.

name: A Gentleman's Club
summary: In the male dominated world of the Albany Club, there is much consternation caused when a woman is appointed as assistant secretary.

name: Everyday Cooking
summary: Samantha Seneviratne reveals that even on your busiest days, every home cooked meal can still be easy, exciting and full of flavor.

name: Fightland
summary:
Fightland follows a disgraced, formerly incarcerated boxing champion who returns to London to seek vengeance against the crime family he thinks betrayed him. With edge-of-seat action and populated by dangerous characters, this is a world of money and power never seen before.

On the night Duke Kilroy becomes world heavyweight champion, a vicious assault leaves his brother, Calvin, dead, causing Duke to snap and results in him spending eight years in a U.S. prison. Upon his release, and after having made a sinister discovery, Duke returns home seeking vengeance against the man he believes set him up -- the criminal kingpin and former promoter, Kingsley Marshall. But Kingsley has vanished, leaving his children and wife, Joy, who happens to be the love of Duke's life, to pick up the pieces.

Working with a cartel desperate to control London's drug market, Duke begins a high-risk game of infiltrating Kingsley's empire to destroy it from within and smoke out his enemy. But amidst a volatile criminal landscape, and competing influences threatening to pull him off course, Duke will need to channel everything that made him a champion fighter into his bloody pursuit to win the ultimate victory - revenge for his brother.

name: The Story of Home
summary: Tara and Percy are interior designers with a passion for old homes. After years of designing for others, now they're taking on a live-in renovation for their own farmhouse in upstate New York.

name: The Cupcake Guys
summary: It was in Tennessee that the men ate and fell in love with Gigi's cupcakes which was based in Nashville and was the largest cupcake franchise brand in the country. After finishing in the league, Griffin opened a franchise of Gigi's Cupcakes in Austin, alongside Orakpo and their longtime friend Bryan Hynson. The Cupcake Guys shows how our cast goes from Football stars to Cupcake Kings.

name: Small Town Christmas
summary: Hosted by Inside Edition's national correspondent and best-selling author Megan Alexander, each episode takes viewers to experience Christmas in a different small town around the country. Through food, drink, music, entertainment and faith, we will highlight local businesses and towns that are making Christmas special in their own unique way.

name: Tin Tem Jai
summary: The lively and adorable Tin has had a life-long dream to marry the older boy in the neighborhood, Park. While the two of them have grown up together, Tin has been rejected countless times, but he still can't quite get over the boy next door. In order to make his dream come true, Tin decides to do everything in his power to get together with Park, and to never let his true love slip away!

name: Storefront Stories
summary: The shopkeepers of beautiful and unique shops all over the country uncover the heart, vision and history of their retail spaces.

name: Engineering on the Edge
summary: When the tallest engineering marvels need to be maintained, only a handful of people have the courage and skills to do the job. Follow Trask Bradbury and his crew as they risk their lives to repair America's tallest and most inaccessible structures.

name: Kan Çiçekleri
summary: The story of Dilan, whose dreams and hopes were taken from her on one hand, and Baran, who had to marry on the other to end the feud and save her brother from this cycle. However, this marriage is a prison for the two of them, and his uncle, who is eyeing his wealth, wants to rekindle the feud. This conflict-filled relationship will bring strong winds between two hearts; Will this marriage turn into a real marriage?

name: Far From Home
summary: A financially struggling teen finds himself in the world of luxury after a prestigious scholarship sends him to an exclusive school for the one percent.

name: Modern Love Amsterdam
summary: In the drama series Modern Love Amsterdam we follow six stories about love and how love always wins when faced with life's challenges and tough situations. From realizing a wish to have children to struggling with the challenges of an open relationship. From mourning over a lost love from the past to accepting new love and adapting to the future. Love, in all its forms, is universal.

name: Summer Job
summary: They're young, spoiled, lazy and thought they were escaping the Italian winter for their dream vacation — but there's a catch to the luxury.

name: How I Caught My Killer
summary:
How I Caught My Killer is a true-crime docu-series that highlights the real-life stories behind unique homicide cases with in-depth interviews, authentic archival material and cinematic recreations all packaged together, giving a fresh spin to the genre.

Whether it's a fraught letter to a friend, an urgent text message detailing a heated argument, a private diary entry describing a horrifying experience, or an ominous social media post revealing a motive for murder…these victims all leave a case-breaking clue that will one day help to solve their crime.

Every curated case details a complex portrait of a human being whose life was cut short by a killer that would have escaped justice if it hadn't been for the victim's own actions. Ultimately, the twists and turns of the investigations into these victim-solved crimes expose an awful truth in America today: our systemic failures as a nation all too frequently deny many citizens justice. Each episode forces us to confront the harsh reality that our system is blind to many underserved and invisible communities that make up a disproportionate percentage of the people who lose their lives to homicide every year.

previousepisode.name: I Know That There is True Evil Out There

name: Oasis
summary: A period drama set in a turbulent Republic of Korea from the 1980s to the 1990s. It contains the fierce life, revenge, and conflict of young people who had to live after power and wealth regardless of means or means in wrong social values.

name: History's Greatest Heists with Pierce Brosnan
summary: Since the creation of currency, money has made the world go round and people have done anything and everything in their power to get their hands on a lot of it, including formulating some of the most devious and high-stakes heist attempts of all time. Using dramatic recreations, dynamic storytelling and cutting-edge visual effects, alongside first-person witness accounts from the people who were there, History's Greatest Heists with Pierce Brosnan delves into the intricate schemes and audacity of the criminal masterminds who risked their freedom for a shot at a lifetime of wealth and riches. Brosnan, who is embedded into each heist through state-of-the-art technology, brings each global news headline to life by putting viewers at the heart of the action and breaking down every aspect of the plan including the conniving team, the mark, the execution and finally the aftermath.

name: Sewer Divers
summary: Sewer Divers takes audiences on a journey through the outdated, centuries old sewer systems in key cities across the U.S. that are maintained by the brave workers who do the job most people wouldn't dare to even think about. From broken pipes to eye opening clogs, these workers will take viewers with them as they dive down deep to do all they can to keep our clean water running and toilets flushing.

name: Real Time Crime
summary: Police and communities have a new weapon in the fight against crime. Across America, Real Time Crime Centers use surveillance cameras, tracking systems, and gunshot detectors to solve crimes and bring criminals to justice. Every episode of this pulse-racing series features two high-octane stories with life and death stakes. Filmed across nine states, with exclusive access to nerve centers from New York to New Orleans, each story includes incredible CCTV footage along with interviews with the major protagonists – police solving the crimes, witnesses, and the families of the victims.

name: Hayatımın Şansı
summary: Yonca, is a young mother in her mid-twenties trying to hold on to life with her youngest daughter Sare. On the one hand, she is struggling with the difficulties of life alone, on the other hand, she is dealing with the custody case of Sare's biological father. When everything hits a dead end, she receives a life-changing offer. Now a new life begins for Yonca. But little does she know that; while escaping from the rain, she will be caught by hail.

name: Lupin Zero
summary: How did this young boy become notorious gentleman thief "Lupin III"? Loosely based on Young Lupin III from the original manga, Lupin Zero will tell a nostalgic, yet brand new original story, finally lifting the veil cast upon Lupin III's humble beginnings. Set during the era in which the original series was first published, the anime depicts Young Lupin III running around the streets of 1960's Japan during the country's economic boom. A young boy climbs the staircase to villainhood. What was he thinking and what steps did he take? This is the untold origin story of the world's greatest thief.

previousepisode.name: Boy Lupine calls himself the Third

name: Ultra Galaxy Fight: The Destined Crossroad
summary: The heroes of the Ultra League split up to do all they can to rescue Yullian. On Planet Juran, a dangerous Absolutian vanguard approaches and fight with Ultraman Cosmos. Meanwhile, the Parallel Isotopes Ultraman Belial and Ultraman Tregear are working with Absolute Tartarus in The Kingdom, and they come across the source of the Absolutian's power. Ultra Heroes vs Absolutians, the destinies of the two forces came to a crossroad

name: Leaving L.A.
summary: Drama with black humour about the Los Angeles County Coroner's office, where the employees examine the recently deceased.

name: The Irish Civil War
summary: Three-part documentary telling the epic and often challenging story of the origins, conflict and legacy of the civil war that took place in Ireland in 1922 and 1923

name: Orleans
summary: A drama about the Charbonnet family of New Orleans, consisting of Luther, a respected judge, and his sons Clade, a police officer, and Jesse, an assistant district attorney, plus his daughter Paulette, manager of the city's principal riverboat casino.

name: Roomies
summary: Bibi and Ama are two lesbian friends in their early twenties. Hoping to become a better version of themselves, they move in together in an apartment in Brussels. Each in their very own way, but under the very same roof they come to share at least one new insight: coming out doesn't mean coming clean.

name: Canadiens Nordiques - La rivalité
summary: A look back at the fierce Canadiens-Nordiques rivalry that divided Quebec for 15 years. One of the most important sporting rivalries in North America.

name: MILF Manor
summary: From cities all across the country, eight confident and strong-minded women leave home for the chance to find love at a paradise destination in TLC's brand-new, love and relationship dating series, MILF MANOR. Although they may be a few years older than the average dating show contestant, these women are not out of practice. Ranging from 40 to 60 years young, this vibrant group brings their unique life experiences to the game. They have decades of dating experience and will use it to find a lasting connection with men half their age. However, nothing can prepare them for a jaw dropping surprise that will greet them at the front door.

name: Rico to the Rescue
summary: Rico León steps in to help Denver homeowners salvage renovations that have gone off the rails. Driven by his parents' past experience with a crooked contractor, Rico is an advocate for desperate families who need an empathetic expert to fix their stressful situations. In each episode, he and his skilled team will tour the house to assess the projects, work to resolve issues with the builder, and create a renovation and design plan to turn the construction nightmare into a beautiful home.

name: Gold, Lies & Videotape
summary: One family has been fighting for over 70 years to recover what they say is rightfully theirs - a $28 billion treasure buried deep inside a mountain in the New Mexico desert. Some believe the U.S. Government stole the 16,000 gold bars and priceless artifacts, while skeptics claim it never existed. Now, for the first time ever, the family and its supporters reveal exclusive evidence to prove their case and crack open the mystery of America's greatest treasure story. The truth of Victorio Peak has never been told... until now.

name: Siempre Reinas
summary: This series follows the lives of Mexican show biz queens Lucía Méndez, Laura Zapata, Sylvia Pasquel and Lorena Herrera as they reinvent themselves.

name: Diğer Yarım
summary: Two twin sisters, who grew up separately and with different values, come together again.

name: I Got a Story to Tell
summary: This thriller anthology series takes viewers down a dark, unsettling path of extraordinary situations where love, lust and terror cross paths.

name: Log Jam
summary: Music-based events of forest animals, which, with the help of improvised musical instruments composed of bear, wolf and hare, "perform" in various ways through the forest. His "performance" is often disturbed by the hunter and his dog, but fortunately the hunter is not receptive enough to pose a real danger to the animals.

name: Полет бабочки
summary: A young spectacular woman Svetlana with her 10-year-old daughter Galya settles in an old elite house. It turns out that she ran away from Paris from her ex-French husband, who is going to take her daughter away from her. One of the neighbors, the famous antiquarian Andrei Kovalevsky, has a son who is the same age as Galochka. Children very quickly find a common language, which brings together their mothers - Svetlana and Irina Kovalevskaya. Soon Andrei, wanting to help the unfortunate neighbor, takes her to work in his antique salon. This will give Svetlana arguments for the French court to keep her daughter with her. The relationship between Kovalevsky and Svetlana very quickly turns into a romantic course, which Irina immediately understands. The usual love triangle? Not at all! Since an international swindler, FSB officers, the allegedly lost masterpiece of Kazimir Malevich and the disease of Kovalevsky's son, which is exacerbated by overexcitation, will intervene in the story.

name: Taaza Khabar
summary: A public toilet caretaker's poverty-stricken life takes a drastic U-turn when he helps an old woman. How long will fate smile upon him?

name: Warhammer 40,000
summary: Warhammer 40,000 is set in the far future, where humanity stands at the edge of what might be its brightest future, or its darkest age. The threats to humankind's empire are many — traitors driven by the fires of ambition, alien empires sworn to reclaim the stars, and the corruption of reality by malevolent gods.

name: Pauly
summary: Slacker Pauly Sherman schemes to ruin the relationship between his wealthy father, Edward, and a gold-digging fiancee, Dawn Delaney.

name: Prince Street
summary: A covert unit of NYPD undercover detectives use unorthodox tactics to infiltrate organized crime.

name: The Rhythm of Life
summary: The Beatles' producer George Martin talks to some of the world's most influential musicians and singers about the meaning of music.

name: Love Syndrome
summary: An unexpected accident left Day with serious injuries, making Itt blame himself for what happened to him. What will It do when Day wakes up with no memory at all? The person who used to be so caring and so loving has become so ruthless?

name: Van-pires
summary: A meteorite turns a team of young gearheads mentored by a former roadie for The Rolling Stones into car vampires. It also creates an evil car vampire overlord who feeds on other cars. To save the world, they must stop his vampire car pack.

name: Ningen Fushin no Boukensha-tachi ga Sekai wo Sukuu you desu
summary: Nick used to be a member of a veteran adventurer party, helping his undisciplined friends with the accounts whenever he could. But what was his reward? Getting accused of embezzlement and kicked out by the leader he respected. Before long, he finds a few other jaded adventurers and kindred spirits, and together, they form their own unstoppable party!

previousepisode.name: Adventurers Can't Save the World Yet

name: Mike Yarwood In Persons
summary: Sketches and impressions from Mike Yarwood, with various special guests each week.

name: Adriano Imperador
summary: A feature-length documentary limited series about one of Brazil's greatest soccer legends - Adriano, The Emperor. Passing briefly through his soccer career, the film will unveil the story behind the athlete's life. Fame, personal conflicts, family, and above all, the love he had for his origins. A boy who grew up in one of Brazil's largest favelas, Vila Cruzeiro, to become a soccer idol who declined million-dollar contracts, fame and fortune to be able to live alongside "his people". Conflicts, fame, money, depression, humility, mainstream media, cars, women and soccer, are all themes that gravitate around "Adriano, The Emperor's" controversial universe.

name: Classic Homes
summary: Explore the architecture and design of the classic homes around US cities. Explore beautiful structures that have passed the test of time and earned their place as archetypes in some of America's most iconic regions.

name: Ice Cold Catch
summary: The hard-working cod fishing crews of Iceland risk everything in ice-cold Arctic waters in search of their fortunes. On board are rookies from Britain and America hoping they've got what it takes to earn a share of the catch.

name: Bake It 'Til You Make It
summary: From cake conventions to cookie shows, thousands of passionate, creative bakers are rising to the occasion in competitive baking as they create masterful, award-winning edible art from their home kitchens. The new docu-series, Bake It 'Til You Make It, premiering on Monday, December 26th at 9pm ET/PT on Food Network, gives an inside look into the unique world of competitive baking and the extremely enthusiastic, over-the-top personalities that participate. Narrated by master cake artist Duff Goldman, the series follows seven competitive bakers as they obsessively pursue their dreams of sweet victory in some of the toughest baking competitions in the country.

name: Stab That Cake!
summary: Three bakers, at the top of their game, compete to see if their hyper-realistic cakes can pass for real world items when placed right next to actual items found in the grocery store. Hosts John Henson and Jocelyn Delk Adams task the bakers to make and then hide their cakes in plain sight throughout a grocery store setting, where two teams of cake fans will race to determine what is real and what is cake. The bakers must use every innovative and creative technique in their arsenal to make their cakes look just like the real deal! The challenges will increase in difficulty to make the cake artists push their cakes and skills to the next level.

previousepisode.name: I Can't Believe It's Not Butter

name: Invert: Jozuka Hisui Toujoshu
summary:
Adapted from the novel "Invert: Jozuka Hisui Toujoshu" (invert 城塚翡翠 倒叙集) by Aizawa Sako (相沢沙呼). 

Invert: Jozuka Hisui Toujoshu is the sequel of previous work Reibai Tantei Jozuka Hisui. This is the first time in the renzoku drama history where the same main character is featured in two separate dramas with different titles and posters.

name: Tomorrow's Peach
summary: A story of violent revenge and the ambitions of a family that falls apart one by one.

name: Jamie vs Britney: The Father Daughter Trials
summary: Was Pop star Britney right to blame her father for her controversial conservatorship? This series tells the story from both perspectives. It looks at Jamie's side for the first time and hears Britney's story with rarely seen first person accounts.

name: Кинопоиск: Культовые сериалы
summary: A series about television and streaming shows that changed the world. Each episode is dedicated to one TV hit - from Breaking Bad and Smeshariki to Seventeen Moments of Spring and The Office.

name: Cheating Men Must Die
summary:
All encounters in this world are reunions after a long absence.

Adapted from the comic "Wan Zha Chao Huang" (万渣朝凰) by Shi Dai Man Wang (时代漫王).

name: МечтаЮ
summary:
How many girls dream of seemingly completely simple, but at the same time completely unrealizable things.

The new reality show on Yu will prove that each of them, regardless of age, social status and profession, can achieve their cherished desire!
The participants are waiting for internal and external transformation, personal growth, overcoming themselves and working with a super team that will do everything to make the dream come true by the end of the graduation!

name: Краш
summary: Bloggers Plague Party and Vanya Rzhevsky open a detective-romantic agency. Through social networks, the presenters will find out everything about the second half of the client who has contacted them and will arrange an ideal date, for which crash will definitely put a like.

name: Пропрованс. Драматические истории
summary: Provence. Dramatic stories "- a TV show about people, about their lives and, of course, about food. Real gastromaniac

name: Trial by Fire
summary: After the deadly Uphaar cinema fire, two grief-stricken parents navigate the loss of their kids and a dogged fight for justice. Based on true events.

name: Couples Therapy Australia
summary: Therapist Marryam is faced with three very different couples' challenges. Scott wants Brendon to cut down his drinking, Polly and Stef have parenting conflicts and Cat and Doug are in a relationship where Cat is in love with two men.

name: Bullshit
summary:
A powerful drama set in 1980s Copenhagen, Pia and Mackerel's passionate love story unfolds against the high-octane backdrop of the "Bullshit" biker gang.

Inspired by actual events, Bullshit tells the dramatic story of a group of lost youth in late 70s and early 80s Copenhagen. They find community and belonging in the biker gang 'Bullshit' – but end up in brutal conflict. 

Pia is only sixteen when she finds the courage to leave her family. All she takes with her is 100 Kroner and a desire to be part of a community. Henning, eighteen, known as "Mackerel", has also turned his back on the acceptable society of the late 70s. He dreams of brotherhood, freedom, and motorcycles. He fights his way into Bullshit, eventually becoming its President and Pia becoming his beloved wife. Life is good for a moment, but Mackerel finds himself in a bloody war against the Hells Angels, and there is no going back. 

The series is based on the Cavling award-winning non-fiction book 'Bullshit: The Story of a Family' by Camilla Stockmann and Janus Køster-Rasmussen.

name: Jana - Märkta för livet
summary:
When a high-ranking head of the Swedish Migration Agency is found murdered in his home, the list of suspects is long. Assistant Prosecutor, Jana Berzelius soon realises that the murder has something to do with her own background and steps in to participate in the investigation. As she attends a boy's autopsy, she see a familiar scar on his neck. Cut into his flesh are markings which trigger in her a flash of memory from her own dark childhood. To get closer to the truth of her own horrific hidden past, she must find the perpetrator behind these murders before the police do. Brilliant but emotionally cold, just like her famous prosecutor father, Jana finds herself drawn deeper and deeper into this dark and mysterious investigation, as more of her sinister memories are awakened. 

Based on award winning crime writer Emelie Schepp's novels sold in more than 3 million copies across 30 countries.

name: Åremorden
summary: Police officer Hanna Ahlander has been suspended from her job in Stockholm and dumped by her partner when she moves to her sister's vacation home in Åre. When a young woman goes missing on the icy night of Lucia, Hanna can't help but start investigating the case. With a tough family situation and an understaffed police station, local police officer Daniel Lindskog reluctantly has to accept Hanna's help. But the big question is whether they can trust each other.

name: Flukten med Norges gull
summary: The documentary series about how the Norwegian government, through a secret operation carried out by a group of unlikely people, managed to smuggle 49 tonnes of gold out of the country during the Nazi invasion in April 1940.

name: Jul med Camp Kulinaris
summary: Four former participants from Camp Culinaris are challenged in fun competitions, and in each program one participant remains with the title of tonight's Christmas chef.

name: Styckmordet ingen vill lösa
summary: After confessing her intent to divorce, Kristina is killed by her husband Holger. This intense documentary delves into the enigmatic case.

name: Nadia Nadim - Game Changer?
summary: Nadia Nadim is an internationally renowned soccer player who came to Denmark as a refugee from war-torn Afghanistan and won the nation's heart, becoming Dane of the Year. Having moved to the U.S. to play for Racing Louisville FC, her sights were set on the 2022 Euro World Cup, when injury struck.

name: Outsideren Henrik
summary: In this series we get an exclusive insight into the life of the controversial and successful alpinist, by following him and his team through one of the most dramatic seasons of his career.

name: Predikantens dubbelliv
summary: Father of small children, happily married, preacher in the parish and a seemingly well-ordered life. But he hides a dark secret. To "relieve his anxiety" he goes out and threatens, molests and rapes women.

name: Att lösa ett mord
summary: Helena Andersson's disappearance has haunted the Swedish police for over 30 years. The case is still unsolved, but the investigative journalist Fredrik Undevik now succeeds in uncovering new and crucial information.

name: Powerwomen Norge
summary: Get to know Anita Krohn Traaseth, Isabelle Ringnes, Leah Behn, Ingeborg Heldal and Iman Meskini better. The five enterprising leading women are great in their respective fields and in this series we get a close look at their careers and private lives.

name: Drømmeren - Karen Blixen bliver til
summary: The story of one woman's struggle to find her place in life while freeing herself from the expectations of family and society. The series takes place in the 1930s and follows Karen Blixen's return to her childhood home Denmark after many years in East Africa.

name: Den svenska terroristen
summary: He was one of the masterminds behind some of the worst terrorist attacks of the decade. This is the unimaginable story of how a young man, born and raised in Malmö, became one of Europe's most notorious terrorists.

name: Hell's Paradise
summary: Gabimaru the Hollow, a ninja of Iwagakure Village known for being cold and emotionless, was set up by his fellow ninja and is now on death row. Tired of killing and betrayal, he wants to die. However, no method of execution works on him because as much as the seemingly apathetic Gabimaru refuses to admit it, he does have a reason to live. He wants to return to his wife, who was the reason why he softened up and failed to be an effective assassin. Thus, he refuses to die. Asaemon the Decapitator, a famous executioner, sees this and has a proposal for the ninja. He wants Gabimaru to join an expedition to an island south of Japan in search of the elixir of life in exchange for a full pardon by the Shogunate. However, this island isn't a normal island: it's believed to be Paradise. However the island is full of mysteries, and the exploring team—consisting of those marked for death—might not be fully prepared to handle them.

name: Eleita
summary: Fefê, a digital influencer who decides to run for governor of Rio de Janeiro as a joke, ends up winning the election.

name: An American Family
summary: An American Family examined the daily trials and tribulations of The Loud family of Santa Barbara, California, and is widely referred to as the first example of an American reality TV show.

previousepisode.name: Lance Loud!: A Death in an American Family

name: The Big House
summary: The Big House is a documentary series profiling various prisons all over the United States.

name: Romesh Ranganathan: The Cynic
summary: Going back to his hometown of Crawley, England, Romesh Ranganathan will talk about vegan-ism, his kids - and offers a peek into the making of his comedy special.

name: Sound of Freedom - Der Soundtrack der Freiheit
summary: 200 years of music of freedom, of hope, of protest: The two-part documentary "Sound of Freedom" goes back to the roots - shows rebels, lateral thinkers and peace fighters. From "Marseillaise" to "Bella Ciao" to "I Will Survive," songs have changed the course of history and become iconic signature tunes.

name: United Kingdom of Pop
summary: In the two-part cultural documentary United Kingdom of Pop, Signed Media pays homage to Europe's mostinnovative pop superpower and presents the main genres, their stars sand subcultures in the form of film essays. United Kingdom of Pop revisits the most important protagonists and contemporaries behind the crucial lines of development over the past decades, reviews them with experts and categorises them. In the course of this process, United Kingdom of Pop also follows up the most important political, cultural and economic events that are reflected in the country's pop culture, and celebrates the open and multicultural spirit that has made British pop culture so great and so unique.

name: Viss Norm
summary: A typical Gen-Z youth tries to live a normal life after witnessing a tragic accident in his childhood, but the special ability he gained because of the event is still haunting him.

In a distant village in Northern Italy, the events of Alex, twenty-one years old who has lived all his life alone with his mother, are intertwined with that of Doctor Petrov, an elderly psychotherapist with an unusual interest in solving local and non-local crimes.

A strange and mysterious object is found, and from that moment everything seems to degenerate into a supernatural nightmare.

name: Петр I: Последний царь и первый император
Celts: The Untold Story
summary: This 3-part documentary series will delve into the mysteries, myths, and arcane history of the CELTS, and reveal brand new information about the ancient civilization.

name: Mystery Places
summary: The Earth has an infinity of magnificent places that are a great attraction to host every year many tourists from all over the world who fall in love with these landscapes. However, there are also a large number of sites around the world that only a few brave dare to tread and that capture the attention of all lovers of unanswered enigmas.

name: Wildlife ER
summary: A range of dedicated professionals and volunteers look after unwell animals and carefully nurse them back to health at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital in Brisbane, Australia.

name: Ferry: de serie
summary: Desperate for funds, Ferry Bouman stumbles upon a golden opportunity when a high-profile bust leaves a vacant position among Brabant's top dealers.

name: Living on the Edge: The Wadden Sea
summary: Living on the Edge goes inside the lives of (e.g.) a group of grey seals, shell ducks and a family of peregrine falcons in the Wadden Sea, a sea which changes completely over the seasons or even a couple of times per day. At one moment, it is kilometers of extensive tidal flats full of life and at another a mass of water with reckless waves; all tied to the invisible influence of the moon and the sun on the tides.

name: Song of the Moon
summary:
Adapted from the novel "Ben Yue" (奔月) by Shu Ke (蜀客).
Young Liu Shao meets a mysterious man with whom she exchanges her future for three full days of happiness. Initially, she has led the carefree life of an heiress until she became embroiled in the battle between the immortals and the demons. Her involvement leads to the unravelling of several romantic entanglements between herself and Lu Li, the cloaked immortal shrouded in mystery.

name: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
summary:
Along with three other heroes, 27-year-old Mukouda Tsuyoshi is transported into a fantasy world to rescue a kingdom from a mysterious threat. However, it soon becomes clear that Tsuyoshi has been dragged into the summoning ritual by accident. His only skill turns out to be "Food Menu," which allows him to open an interface where he can purchase and obtain food-related supermarket items from modern Japan.

Unceremoniously booted out of the palace, Tsuyoshi sets out on his own into his new world. However, his ability to create delicious dishes unknown to this world soon pays dividends, even attracting the legendary wolf Fenrir. Fenrir is so taken in by the food that the creature immediately forms a contract with Tsuyoshi, becoming his familiar. Followed by this whimsical mythical being, Tsuyoshi takes up a job as a merchant and adventurer, travelling and cooking up mouth-watering meals that never fail to amaze the inhabitants of this world.

name: Unsung Cinderella: Byoin Yakuzaishi no Shohosen
Mech Cadets
summary: Fifty years in the future, after a terrifying alien species attacked our planet, teenager Stanford Yu works as a janitor at the Sky Corps Military Academy. But he's only dreamed of one thing his entire life — to pilot a Robo Mech, giant robots from outer-space who came to our aid. When he finally gets his shot, Stanford and his classmates must put aside all personal differences and work together as a team in order to defend humanity against a new invasion of aliens.

name: The National Lottery Parties
summary: A series of special shows presented by the National Lottery.

previousepisode.name: The National Lottery's New Year's Eve Big Bash

name: Four Corners
summary: Four Corners was a short-lived primetime soap opera that aired on CBS. It is notable as Ann Margret's TV series debut, and for being canceled after only two episodes. The series was produced by Dallas and Knots Landing creator David Jacobs.

name: Children of the New Forest
summary: Captain Marryat tells the narrative of adolescent mischievous behavior during the Protectorate era in the exquisitely crafted Children of the New Forest. The youngsters support the king, but the local roundhead opposition is made up of Stalinist thugs who chant hymns and are commanded by a crazy Leveller clergyman. The story revolves around ideas like loyalty and duty, which even the tiniest kids are shown to comprehend sufficiently to put their lives in danger for their king.

name: What Six Survivors Told…
summary: Young men and women of different ages and occupations lived in a siege and lived a cheerful and "special" life. If they go outside, it's a hell full of zombies. However, the shopping mall is a safe area full of leftover supplies.

name: Break Point
summary: Travel alongside some of the world's most talented tennis players as they swing for greatness and Grand Slams through an action-packed season.

name: Love of Secret
summary: Panpan is a medical student with a dream of becoming an idol. She's forced to conceal that dream because her father is a famous surgeon, Phuri, who hopes his daughter will go on to become a doctor like himself. What's more, Panpan is concealing her relationship with Aitim, her girlfriend, best friend, and biggest fan.

name: The Deep
summary: The Deep centers on a research station at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean, where a miraculous discovery signals a new hope for humanity – but secrets unearthed on the ocean floor might hold devastating consequences for the world above.

name: The Killing Kind
summary:
The Killing Kind follows successful barrister Ingrid, who is used to dealing with tricky clients, but no one rivals John Webster—charming, good-looking, successful and clever and accused of coercive control by an ex-girlfriend.

Following the trial, Ingrid got close to Webster—too close—and when she tried to exit the relationship, he turned on her, and her world imploded. Now, just when she is rebuilding her life, he suddenly reappears and tells her that someone is out to kill her and only he can protect her.

name: Тайны следствия
summary: The show revolves around the Deputy Prosecutor Maria Shvetsova and her team who investigate the most difficult crimes in Saint Petersburg.

name: Myrtle Beach Bowl
summary:
The Myrtle Beach Bowl is an NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS) college football bowl game first played in December 2020 in the Myrtle Beach metropolitan area. Coastal Carolina University hosts the game at its Brooks Stadium in Conway, South Carolina, which has a capacity of 20,000 seats following an expansion project completed prior to the 2019 season. Owned by ESPN Events, the bowl has tie-ins with Conference USA, the Mid-American Conference and the Sun Belt Conference.

In June 2018, the NCAA indicated that the Grand Strand area was approved for a bowl game. The Myrtle Beach Bowl was subsequently announced on November 13, 2018, by ESPN Events.

previousepisode.name: 2025 Myrtle Beach Bowl: Kennesaw State Owls vs. Western Michigan Broncos

name: Toxisch
summary: After six months of complete radio silence, Emma unexpectedly invites her four best friends to a holiday home in an idyllic snowy landscape. Here they are finally to meet Emma's mysterious boyfriend Noah. But the group of friends quickly suspects that something is very wrong.

name: Hollywood Safari
summary: The Johnson family has made a business out of their love for animals by training them for movies. The remarkable Johnson family embarks on thrilling adventures as they prepare some of the world's most exotic animals for starring roles on the silver screen. With Muddy the dog, Plato the monkey, and a host of fascinating creatures, their lives are anything but ordinary. The family dynamic adds even more excitement. Josh, the daring son, thrives on adrenaline and constantly seeks adventure, while his younger brother Peter has an extraordinary gift for connecting with animals of all kinds. The story takes a dramatic turn when the untamed wilderness collides with the glamorous world of Hollywood. It's up to Troy Johnson, a renowned animal trainer, and his captivating wife Jayne to restore order and harmony amidst the chaos. Packed with action, adventure, heartwarming moments, and family fun, Hollywood Safari proves that with determination and teamwork, nothing is out of reach!

name: The Dreamer: Condo/Barista/Architect
summary: Pongkhwan is an architect who believes in green design. She tries to hold up those standards both in her work and in her daily life. She receives a job designing a condominium delivering green design and eco-living. It's exactly her thing, but nothing about it proves easy. Pongkhwan's junior colleague Ted likes to tease her playfully. Just as their rivalry is giving way to a new closeness, Pong meets Tle, a barista who runs a shop near her home. What starts as a customer-shopkeeper relationship soon turns into a close friendship. It seems that their closeness won't stop at just being friends.

name: Tropiques amers
summary: The life of a sugar cane plantation in Martinique, over a period preceding the French Revolution until the restoration of slavery in 1802 by Napoleon, which will cause the general uprising of the slaves.

name: Dirty Old Cars
summary: Across America, under layers of dust, mold, mud, and grime, thousands of gorgeous cars are waiting for someone to come along and give them the one thing they need to get back on the road: A GOOD BATH.

name: Love Formula 11M
summary: "Love Formula 11M" will show the everyday struggles of youths. It tells the story of Ji Yoon, a girl who lives as a regular college student after experiencing an injury that forces her to give up on her dream of becoming a soccer player. The drama follows the romance between Ji Yoon and her good-looking upperclassman Tae Oh.

name: Оливье и роботы
summary: A fantastic comedy about the everyday life of Russians in the high-tech world of the future. Robots, clones, artificial intelligence and us: how will technological progress affect ordinary people? The answer is in six unusual, witty and life-affirming stories with movie stars in each episode.

name: Отель у овечек
summary: The story of a friendly family of sheep who opened a hotel in their old mansion. In each episode, Bella the sheep and her older brother Benya meet new guests and help their parents in their free time from games and school. Children are so eager to turn the hotel into the most popular vacation spot in the city that they often find themselves in comical situations.

name: РАЙцентр
summary: In the village of Varmalei, former classmates gather for the twentieth anniversary of graduation. A glorious anniversary is overshadowed by a car caught from the pond, which has lain at the bottom since the commemorative graduation. Inside - a corpse and an unusual stone, which turns out to be a meteorite. The investigation, as if into a funnel, draws in all those who gathered to celebrate: it exacerbates old conflicts, confuses the already complicated relations between former classmates and their teachers. Everyone learns something shocking about themselves and others: who they were in the 90s, who they have become and what they are capable of in the present.

name: Детектив Финник
summary: Do you think Berg is a quiet and peaceful town? Whatever it is, it is full of secrets and mysteries. Suddenly all the clocks will stop, then a ghost tram will pass along the rails, then suddenly all the streets will be filled with strange dogs. But residents can sleep peacefully, because Finnick, the world's first brownie detective, is on guard. This detective has a unique trial and error method and is always ready to defend his friends and the whole city. Secrets, come to light!

name: Соцсети
summary: A web series about the loneliness of a modern person in the digital world and the total impact of social networks on relationships between people. The action takes place in the near future in Tomsk. The heroes of the dramedy actively use new technologies and cannot imagine their life without them. Will they be able to cope with temptations and not destroy relationships with loved ones?

name: Gekikoi
summary: Miyuu stopped trusting men after her father's affair with a different woman. However, her heart chose a person to love despite of her negative emotions

name: Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible
Безсоновъ
summary: A young man from the noble noble family of the Bezsonovs, Nikolai, by chance and at the behest of his heart becomes an ordinary detective police official. His colleagues receive him coldly, and only the experienced official Pyotr Romanovich Shchukin sees in the young man a future detective star. Together they are trying to uncover a chain of mysterious and dangerous crimes committed either in the city slums or in the boudoir of a socialite.

name: Nick Arcade
summary: Competitors vie in an interactive video playground.

name: Ben Gri
summary: The life of Fuat Akıncı, a successful and respected lawyer, changes when his daughter experiences an unfortunate event. Seeking revenge, Fuat responds to mysterious messages sent to his phone that will eventually turn his life upside down and make him confront his past in the middle of darkness and light.

name: The Secret Life of Amy Bensen
summary: At eighteen, tragedy and a dark secret force Amy to flee all she has known and loves to start a new life. Now years later, just when she lets down her guard, the ghosts of her past are quick to punish her, forcing her back on the run. On a plane, struggling to face the devastation of losing everything again and starting over, Amy meets Liam Stone, a darkly entrancing recluse billionaire, who is also a brilliant, and famous, prodigy architect. A man who knows what he wants and goes after it. And what he wants is Amy. Refusing to take "no" for an answer, he sweeps her into a passionate affair. He wants to possess her. He makes her want to be possessed. But what if she is too devastated by tragedy to know when he wants more than she should give? And what if there is more to Liam than meets the eyes?

previousepisode.name: Field of Dreams; Dani's Tale; Acres of Hope; Holly's Helping Hand

name: High (School) On Sex
summary: Hilariously sexy coming of age series which follows group of high school students and their sexual life through their high school years.

name: Romantic Witch's Starlight Sonata
summary: Love never waits. The secret door opens widely only for whom tries to get. Jeongyoon, always say what she want to say. Yejin, always depend on Jeongyoon. They keep playing hot and cold with or without notice each other. One day, the shadow came in front of Jeongyoon and Yejin. Everything changes on the night with darkness.

name: In This Kaleidoscope World
summary: An experimental film that tackles story of love; love has no boundaries and has no gender. It mainly focused on three way love.

name: Love Bites
summary: Short, sweet, and bite-sized love stories.

name: My Fairy Ghost
summary: Aizawa Riko made her debut as a popular novelist with her first novel. However, after that, no matter how many proposals she submitted, she became afraid to express herself. Meanwhile, Riko helps Hasui Kei, a genius painter who has become a ghost because she has a regret in this world. Kei helps Riko with her writing novel. Riko and Kei begin to fall in love with each other even though Kei might disappear... A short romance WLW drama between a ghost and a human woman!

name: You I Didn't Know
summary: Ep. 1 Tae Il is frustrated by her girlfriend's endless obsessions. Ep. 2 Ji Won is sad when she's left out because her best friend gets a new boyfriend. Ep. 3 Hye Joo can no longer keep her feelings for her old friend Sol to herself. Will things ever go back to the way it used to be when everything was simpler?

name: A Day of Dating
summary: "You know, I thought I could do anything with you. We always love together, we are unhappy together, we cry together." As soon as Joo Young says those words, she recalls the night she was unhappy with. And at the dawn of the breakup, Lee Seo recalls the day she and Joo Young had spoken.

name: Our Relationship Ended Before It Began
Dating Death
summary: The story of Rodney Alcala, who was infamous for his TV dating show appearance during his murder spree, and who was linked to 130 deaths.

name: 42 Kg Nak Kae Nai Gor Rak
summary: Plus she has a boyfriend who she loves him very much. So much that I almost gave everything to this man Because she believes that doing anything for anyone will get the same results as we give. But it's not with this guy. Her boyfriend wants her to have a better body. She bought a pill to gain weight. But when she did everything, her boyfriend still left. . . . There was a woman next door. come into her life She became closer. Until she later found out that this person was a cell that sells weight gain pills. that she used to buy.

name: Happy Ending
summary: The members of DIA star as alternate versions of themselves in this 3-episode web series. Each episode covers a different story: Chaeyeon aids a ghost who's searching for his younger sister, Eunjin struggles with her feelings for her best friend Heehyun, and Jenny follows her friend Yebin into a dangerous situation.

previousepisode.name: The process of giving up on a partner

name: Lilygirl
summary: Girls' love series.

name: Kavos Weekender
summary: The return of the documentary following the lives of British tourists and holiday reps, this time in the Greek party capital of Kavos on the island of Corfu.

name: Live to Lead
summary: In this documentary series, leaders and activists committed to social justice share their life stories.

name: FUBAR
summary: Luke and his daughter Emma have lied to each other for years, both of them not knowing the other is a CIA operative. Once they both learn the truth, they realize they don't actually know anything about each other.

name: Mila no Multiverso
summary: Mila receives as a gift on her sixteenth birthday a device that can take her to visit parallel universes in search of her mother, Elis. Mila will need to adapt quickly to the challenges, and with the help of her friends Juliana, Vinícius and Pierre, she will go in search of her mother, thus living the most incredible adventure in the exploration of the vast multiverse.

previousepisode.name: This Might be my Last Message

name: ¡Dale, dale, dale!
summary: Which of seven competing teams will be the Piñata Heroes? Their piñatas must be colorful and creative, and impress the picky judges: a group of kids!

name: Ponds Theater
summary: One-hour live plays, ranging from comedy to drama, including originals written for television as well as adaptations of well-known literary works.

name: Las Villamizar
summary: Las Villamizar is the historical drama that breaks all the rules, giving life to a historical period from the female point of view. A suspenseful thriller in which 3 sisters born in the highest class are on a mission to avenge their mother, murdered by the Spanish army during the independence era. They will have to fulfill missions that will bring them closer to their goal, putting their heart, their identity and their life at stake. As the story progresses, its main characters are torn between revenge and justice.

previousepisode.name: Las Villamizar se enfrentan en la batalla final contra Montenegro

name: Selección Argentina, la serie - Camino a Qatar
summary: Argentina National Football Team is getting ready for the World Cup and opens the door to behind-the-scenes. The qualifiers, the Copa América, the Finalissima and match preparation for Qatar as never seen before.

name: Yet another Conference
summary: Yet another Conference — An annual big story about Yandex services and products and how they are created.

name: Make a Wish
summary: Dr. Phakphoom who is be able to see ghosts since childhood. Life full of chaos including with seeing patients' ghost. Finding the way to get rid of this hardship He meets up with Angle Krit who has magical power to give blessing to human. Angle Krit accepts the mission but he needs to find human and use their body in order to accomplish this task and find the answer of how Dr. Phakphoom can see ghosts. Using Medical students Pawamet whose his soul was torn apart from mysterious accident. He is willing to help by let Angle Krit use his own body with only one condition, By helping him to find the cause of the accident that make him stay unconscious as sleeping price. The mission is keeping more challenging when Angle Chan give Krit to carry out this mission within 6 days. Angle Krit in Pawamet‘s body together with Dr. Phakphoom work together to solve this mission but it led to more chaotic problems further. The intimacy during the mission creates the trembling feeling toward human. Finally, the answer of all problems has been solved and gear toward to the conclusion of mission to stop seeing ghost that beyond expectation.

name: Oh Baby
summary: Tracy is a successful career woman who longs to be a mom. When her boyfriend refuses to commit, Tracy decides she can't wait around...

name: No script
summary: A series of interconnected scenes, improvised by the two actresses, telling the story of two women's relationship from start to end.

previousepisode.name: Patrick Kielty, Boris Becker, Bruce Forsyth

name: Power Play
summary: Power Play follows Brett Parker, a former New York City sports agent who becomes the general manager of a National Hockey League franchise, the Hamilton Steelheads.

name: Push
summary: Push was a soap opera about a group of young Olympic hopefuls in training at California Southern University.

name: Esaret
summary: The heir of the Demirhan family (Orhun), who burns with a desire to take revenge for the murder of his sister, on the other side (Hira), who has lived all her life under slavery, (Orhun) thinks that she was killed. Her sister though she is innocent.

name: Maestro
summary: A musician goes to lead a festival on a scenic island, where he begins an unexpected romance and finds himself entwined in other people's problems.

name: The Perfect Man
summary: Yeung Yat-cheng, an elite in the bodyguard world, is good at risk management and is the winning team in life. However, his unhappy childhood made him refuse marriage, and fate made him meet Yau Chi-ching, a clever woman who keeps breaking the rules of his life.

name: The Secret Lives of Men
summary: The Secret Lives of Men deals with the lives of three divorced men who have stuck together through most of their lives.

name: The Simple Life
summary: Urbane Sara Campbell pretends to be a perfect rural homemaker. To keep her fortune she moves to the country with mother Muriel, daughter Freddi and a crew to run her TV empire. Luke is the studly farm manager, Will and Charlotte his kids.

name: Style & Substance
summary: Chelsea Stevens is a one-woman cooking, decorating and entertaining machine who thinks every crisis can be solved by a decorative centerpiece. As America's reigning queen of domesticity, style, and gracious living, she has created a media empire consisting of magazines, video, and television spots. Enter small-town girl Jane Sokol, who has been brought to the Big Apple to manage Chelsea's business after she sells it to Ferber Enterprises. Level-headed Jane goes head to head with neurotic control-freak Chelsea in her daily attempts to handle budgets and Chelsea's difficult staff -- not to mention Chelsea's meddling interference in her life.

previousepisode.name: I Went to a Garden Party

name: Autodefensa
summary: Autofiction set in Barcelona in which two friends open the doors of their home, their intimacy and their lives to show without complexes the ups and downs of youth, the difficulty of finding oneself and the lack of control as an escape.

name: No me gusta conducir
summary: By enrolling in the driving school, know-it-all Pablo discovers that he still has a lot to learn. Driving and life in general. As soon as classes start, he meets Yolanda, his student at the university, with whom Pablo establishes a curious relationship: professor and student at the faculty, fellow students at the driving school.

name: Belfast Midwives
summary: The work of the team at the award-winning Royal Jubilee Maternity Service in Northern Ireland.

name: The Caribbean: Billionaires' Paradise
summary: Documentary providing an insight into the lives of those who live in the Caribbean, famous as a playground for the rich and famous.

name: The Kardashians: Billion Dollar Dynasty
summary: From a sex tape to the White House, the remarkable story of how the Kardashians captured the world's imagination, defied their critics, built a family brand and became billionaires

name: Freewheelers
summary: The freewheelers were a group of three young (late teens/early twenties) agents who worked for British Intelligence. Their boss was Colonel Buchan who assigned them onto various adventures around Britain. Each adventure story would last several weeks, and at the end of each episode end on a cliffhanger.

name: Моя жена рулит
summary: The first cooking show where wives control their husbands in the kitchen, with Marina Fedunkiv! In each issue, three married couples compete in the preparation of the same dish. At the same time, husbands do everything with their hands, and wives guide them by audio communication. The couple will have to become a team to win a cash prize, and chef Evgeny Pavlov will evaluate their culinary masterpieces.

name: Women Walk the Line
summary: A pair of post-90s besties have chosen very different paths in life. Upon graduation, one stayed in Shanghai to focus on her career while the other returned to their hometown to get married. In recent years, they encounter unprecedented difficulties. For many years, Yuan Ge has been married to her job and hasn't bothered investing in relationships. As her health takes a hit, she starts to make changes in her life. For eight years, Gu Qiao has made constant concessions for her husband only to be given divorce papers in the end. This time around, she's determined to restart her career. While both ladies have completely different personalities, they are equally tough and brave. In a metropolis full of opportunities, it is easy to lose your away. Not afraid of falling, they are persistent and join hands in overcoming difficulties to complete the transformation of youth and usher in a new chapter in their thirties.

name: Three Meals a Day: Doctors
summary: A new spin-off collaboration between "Hospital Playlist" cast members Jo Jung Suk, Jeon Mi Do, Jung Kyung Ho, Yoo Yeon Seok, and Kim Dae Myung and producing director (PD) Na Young Suk. The show follows the format of Na Young Suk's "Three Meals a Day," where celebrities rent a house in the countryside and cook their own meals from scratch. The format of "Three Meals a Day" is that a small celebrity cast goes to live in a countryside house and make their own meals, often farming or fishing for their own ingredients. In one teaser, just like the previous versions of the show, Jo Jung Suk, Jeon Mi Do, Jung Kyung Ho, Yoo Yeon Seok, and Kim Dae Myung build their own cooking fire, harvest their own apples and turnips, wash their own dishes, and eat the meals that they cook themselves.

name: Three Meals in Iceland
summary:
During tvN's "New Journey to the West 6" last year, Eun Ji Won and Lee Soo Geun won a trip to see the Northern Lights in Iceland during a random prize draw.

Although the pair expressed worry about the long flight they would need to take to collect their prize, they eventually flew out to Iceland on September 1 for a four-day stay.
